No test function, decorator, marker, or assertion changed; no skip/xfail/skipif/importorskip and no type-ignore/noqa were introduced in either version. The prior review's anti-trivial-pass property is therefore preserved untouched, so canned rows, mock injection, ignored input, tautology, fetch-all-then-filter, and key-splitting all remain blocked. Import reordering cannot weaken any guard; it only makes the frozen artifact pass I001.
